title: Conditional κ ≈ 0.001717794984118634663827: two hostee moves and seven retired-lender aliases on #2751's joint twelve-source words
head: 17b2ee6ef3cf1468e78a6267f0ecbc9a0e6f60dd
body:
This extends the words of #2751 (@tekuuu, head `4cfbb0cc`) with seven retired-lender aliases. Five need only exact refits. The other
two are opened by moving two existing borrows onto free retired lenders.

The new conditional κ is **0.001717794984118634663826999…**. The exact rational is `0.001717794984118634663827 - 10^-46 - 10^-70`;
the selected frontier is unchanged.

| over | margin |
|---|---|
| #2751 (tekuuu) | +6.53397770208325718e-7 (exact 326698885104162859/(5·10^23)) |
| #2766 (DavidAriasC) | +5.38010651632355557e-7 (exact 538010651632355557/10^24) |
| #2767 (jeremykothe2) | +5.38010651632355556055e-7 |

**What is new, and what is credited.**
- The certified frames contain, unchanged, #2766's frame refit of #2751's words: B1151 rank 6 -> 5. #2767 reaches the same κ by
  another route.
  - *Corrected after #2847:* the other 19 frame changes (A0-A11, B771/773/776/778/783/788, restore60) were credited to #2766 here by
    mistake. #2766's own words change only B1151. The 19 are this package's `refit5c` choices, and #2847 shows they are
    cost-neutral. The package README and `CLAIM.json` at `17b2ee6e` still carry the old wording.
- New here, worth +5.38e-7 over #2766/#2767:
  - **Five retired-lender aliases** (606<-550, 635<-551, 637<-552, 638<-553, 639<-562), made feasible by exact one-rank refits:
    +1.52e-7.
  - **Two hostee moves** that free two more lenders, plus the two aliases they enable (667<-401, 669<-403): +3.86e-7.

**Construction.**
- Every alias is of the kind of #2679's 653<-563 (philippeVV). A helper enters a retired lender's register through one B warp
  with an explicit invertible `G`, `G(U)=E`; the helper and its private register are gone.
- **Five aliases.**
  - Each lender's last gate drops from rank 6 to 5, its exact floor; each follower's first gate rises from rank 4 to 5, its exact
    ceiling. Both use #2679's frame-lattice tools.
  - The census on #2751's words found no fixed-frame pairs and 35 refit-feasible ones.
- **Hostee moves.** With every existing B-warp hosting treated as movable, the remaining rank-4 followers 667/669/670/671 can enter
  24 hosted lenders whose own lives end in A, but only if each hostee moves to a free retired lender. Only 564 and 565 qualify
  (floor 5, retired at B911/B912 before the hostees enter). That gives 192 augmenting paths, at most two extra aliases.
  - Chosen: warps 30/31 (#2226 borrows; their hostees enter at rank 5 already), moved 401 -> 564 and 403 -> 565.
  - 564/565's last gates are refit from rank 6 to 5. Both warp records are replaced in place, so op ids are kept.
  - 401/403 then take 667 and 669 at fixed frames (dim 4).
- The final program takes its certified optimal frames (#1186 toolkit). The 48 followers with a rank-1 entrance stay infeasible:
  every lender floor is at least 4.

**Result.**
- 408 helpers {4:26, 5:2, 7:62, 8:78, 9:240}, 72 buffers, 666 calls, 271728 roles; physical 66794.
- Local profile `{1:2382,2:648,3:268,4:128,5:26,8:8}`.
- The owner fill is #2751's fill with the seven helpers' 4662 roles removed (renumbered, every bin re-tiled as a prefix). Its
  pattern relaxation has the same optimum.
- Complete profile `{1:1603728,2:431568,3:185082,4:85248,5:27194,8:5328,32:1,48:26558}`; rank mass 4816512.

**Independent checks.**
- #2847 (@thakrarsagar): fresh standard-library code checks the seven stages over #2751 on both words. 28/28 rules pass and all 20
  negative controls are rejected, with no defect found. It reproduces the retired5/retired7 split and corrected the #2766 frame
  credit above.
- Followers 670/671 (@philippeVV, [comment](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2802#issuecomment-6203637793),
  checker `philippeVV/integer-mult-bounds@0610f3de`): no refit of the fixed gate list gives them a lender. With all 72 hostees
  movable, their 74 pairwise-overlapping lives would need the 72 registers whose floor is at most 5, and all of those already host.
  That leaves 0 augmenting paths, so a further alias needs a gate-level edit.

**Packaging.**
- Only `research/t74-joint-twelve-retired7/` is added. #2751's directory is byte-identical.
- The branch is based on #2751's head, so this PR contains #2751's commit until #2751 merges.
- The seven stages `refit5 -> alias5 -> refit5c -> refit7 -> hostmove2 -> alias7 -> refit7c` are new `rebuild_borrow` stages in the
  overlay, with exact structure checks. Each new state passes the auditor.
- Tamper controls: 71 per word. Every mutant re-derives its cleanup, and a stale-cleanup rejection counts as a failure:
  - lender refits undone (`warp frame mismatch`);
  - follower raises undone;
  - per move: lender reverted, move undone, warp before retirement, `G` wrong;
  - #2679's alias suite per alias;
  - corrupted certified frames.

**Checker adaptations (diffs in `RETIRED5-CODE.patch` and `RETIRED7-CODE.patch`, reasons in the README).**
- `independent_owners.py`: the helper count is read from the providers (408) instead of the constant 415. Every check is unchanged.
- `workflow/admit.py`: the derived-source pin (506 files), physical 66794, and strict improvement over #2751.
- `verify.py`: it reproduces #2751's own fill and words, then checks the seven declared stages, the declared compaction, the new pins
  and improvement over #2751/#2766/#2767.
- `verify_retired7.py` and `retired7_controls.py`: new.

**Validation.**
- Full cold release from the committed package through `full_replay.py`: **PASS** (`PASS_T74_JOINT_TWELVE_COLD_COMPLETE_RELEASE`,
  411 s, run cold from the committed package). It covered:
  - all 491 pinned PR2679 files authenticated;
  - the 36-file overlay;
  - four fresh native providers (five stages each);
  - the retained-parent admission;
  - owners, lift, rebind, and discovery/unpin/freeze at #2751's 24-digit precision;
  - the outer ledger and independent derivation;
  - the original `verify_release.py`: PASS_RELEASE, including `rebuild-borrow-words` with all stage checks and controls, the strict
    T74 replay with its admission, bit and independent controls, and the geometry controls.
- Registered hook, about 100 s, budget 1020 s: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-joint-twelve-retired7`.
  - `verify.py` literal review;
  - `verify_retired7.py`: seven-stage rebuild, the vendored byte-identical PR2679 auditor on eight states, 142 tamper controls, the
    literal owner fill, the 80-digit root and κ margins;
  - `packing_cap.py`: cap ≈ 0.00175808593463, realized 0.9771;
  - `test_integrity.py`.
- `python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'`: 69 tests OK (3 skipped).
- Evidence is in `evidence/retired5/` and `evidence/retired7/`, sanitised of local paths.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-joint-twelve-retired7
python3 -B research/t74-joint-twelve-retired7/full_replay.py --work /tmp/FRESH-retired7   # fresh external dir; requirements.txt
```

**Scope.** This is conditional finite construction. All all-size, interface, hosting, precision, recurrence, bit-supplier and outer
obligations of #2751 and its lineage are inherited unchanged. No optimality is claimed beyond the exact census of retired-lender
aliases with movable hostings.

**Credits.**

  refit/search tools and the alias builder);
- jeremykothe2 (#2673/#2745: call order and window-optimal fill, the #2696+#2679 composition, entrance raises, the gmx-t74-borrow43
  package machinery and BORROW-WORD lineage, including the base-word lenders 564/565);
- mason-hale (#2696, the eight-lender assignment);
